name: Evidence Integrity Verification
description: Verifies the integrity of the evidence chain — the cryptographically linked sequence of evaluation records that proves continuous security control operation. Detects tampering, gaps, or corruption in the evidence store.
threat_addressed: If compliance evidence records can be tampered with after generation, the entire compliance posture becomes untrustworthy. Auditors cannot rely on evidence that lacks integrity guarantees.
enforcement_mechanism: Compliance evidence records are integrity-protected through hash chaining (SHA-256). Each record references the hash of the previous record. Periodic verification confirms chain integrity. Breaks in the chain trigger alerts.

security_outcome.pass: Integrity mechanism active on all evidence records. 100% chain verification on schedule. No unresolved integrity alerts.
security_outcome.fail: Evidence chain integrity failure — broken hash chain, missing records, or tampering detected.

display_detail: Verifies the cryptographic hash chain integrity of the evidence store.
remediation_hint_template: Evidence chain integrity failure. Investigate broken hash chain — this may indicate tampering or data corruption.
